User guide

Use batches of the same protein and binding partner. Each LSA workbook must contain one analyte set. You can reuse a primer barcode block or select a different block for each batch. If several blocks share an NGS CSV, select that file for each relevant batch and specify its block.

Use the same condition label for equivalent conditions. Enter a distinct label when the buffer, temperature, assay setup, or another relevant condition changes. Unlabeled batches each form their own condition. Differences in supplied experiment metadata also form separate groups.

The study matches full, validated amino acid sequences across batches. KD, kon, and koff are normalized to their own batch WT. Every observed variant remains traceable, including variants seen just once and records with limited QC. The report explains the descriptive summaries and flags discordant observations.

Structure colors use signed ΔΔG and a shared scale for all batches and conditions. Blue and red mark their respective extrema, with white at zero. The default map combines all batches. Switch maps to compare a condition or a batch. Open structure_study.html from the extracted ZIP to revisit the interactive map offline. The ZIP also includes structure_study.cxc for ChimeraX and residue_colors_study.csv.
